limits: The recovered default notification branch assumes normal ActionProcess and valid notifier/OnlineMatch receiver. It does not certify ActionProcess=false, invalid notifier, pending-kill/GC, exceptions or the full network/receiver lifecycle.
Five library/state functions match saved runtime length/hash/branch operands; notifier/OnlineMatch helpers rely on parsed pak authority and are absent from that saved runtime capture.
Short undefined-in-Ghidra constructor/thunk functions are checked directly against exact installed PE bytes and decoded instruction effects; no user project functions or analysis were modified.
This verifies default construction, missing-lookup notification construction and bounded Pincer caller differences, not all BlueprintJson formatting/number precision or all native property types.
Missing IDs, synthetic nonpositive mappings, detached objects and disappearing maps are controlled probes, not proof real PvP cards necessarily produce these states.
